service.method: SELECT Q.QNA_NUMBER , Q.COMPANY_CODE , Q.SUBJECT , Q.ATTACH_NO , Q.KEYWORDS , Q.CONTENT , Q.ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = Q.HOUSE_CODE AND USER_ID = Q.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME , Q.ADD_DATE , #DB_OWNER#NVL((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SQNAR WHERE HOUSE_CODE = Q.HOUSE_CODE AND QNA_NUMBER = Q.QNA_NUMBER AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'), 0) AS REPLY_CNT , Q.QNA_COMPANY , Q.QNA_TYPE FROM SQNAQ Q WHERE Q.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND Q.QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(Q.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT R.QNA_NUMBER , R.QNA_SEQ , R.ATTACH_NO , R.CONTENT , R.ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = R.HOUSE_CODE AND USER_ID = R.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME , R.ADD_DATE , R.ADD_TIME , DEL_FLAG , R.QNA_COMPANY FROM SQNAR R WHERE R.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND R.QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(R.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY CONVERT(INT,R.QNA_SEQ)
